lun_bawang: Alo, ngadananku Bethel. Ui sikal papu' namu idi lun rurummu
english: Hello, my name is Bethel. I want to meet you and your friends

lun_bawang: Nguten muh ku ticu' faa tinueh lubang dih
english: You will reach into the hole with your right hand

lun_bawang: Labo, naa ngaag tulang bakaa kereb mudan
english: Labo, don’t chop the boar’s bones while it is raining
